scope: Only archived freeze-v4 to freeze-v5 readiness fixture balanced-click observation delta. Prior full source and target-refresh reviews remain separate. No GUI, test, build, runtime/process/signature invocation, source edits, original-evidence edits, staging or commit; only this report written.

assessment.problemAddressed: Parent identified that pure mouse move does not change receiver.counts; a repeat at the same coordinates would evade that count comparison. v5 changes the captured input to one balanced click and proves that the same saved recording actually increments count receipts when dispatched/replayed.
assessment.sequenceValidity: Two left-button events at0 and40000 microseconds, same interior point (pad origin+100,+60), click_state1, flags0, pressure0 and zero deltas. The default exact profile allows that bounded down/up pair; no unmatched held key/button, pressure stage, drag or scroll is added. This is the same shape as the already-reviewed native-entry click.
assessment.targetScope: Remains same receiver child/window and the known720x170 blue pad. InputPad.mouseDown only makes the owned pad first responder, and mouseUp has no product action. No arbitrary window, clipboard operation, key chord or external application is added. Native FocusGuard/target/occlusion and release guards remain product responsibilities.
assessment.directDispatchOracle: After focus and recording-start success, reads before state, dispatches sequence, checks native ok, reads after state, then requires left_down and left_up each exactly previous-or0 plus1 with no held left button or modifiers. Fails into finally before collection and later scenarios if these prerequisites fail.
assessment.savedReplayOracle: Saved recording must still be schema1/one input.sequence with exact file JSON equality. Actual normal-session replay must return completed1/failed0 and receiver down/up each increase exactly1, finishing neutral. Previous successful direct-count assertion guarantees finite numeric baseline counts before this replay comparison.
assessment.refusalOracle: Later negative tests use that same recording/sequence; existing entire counts equality and input/focus audit rejection now independently observe an erroneous delivery of the actual click pair to the owned receiver. Hidden-service current target from v4 is preserved for both macro and nested batch. Expected error codes have not been relaxed.
